name: Slate
description: The workspace: notes, subscriptions and product metrics in one place.
notes: An assistant, on the right (Ctrl+J): ask about your notes, money and apps; it proposes money changes for your Confirm
Pick Claude Code, Codex or Gemini in Settings, Assistant, and connect it with its own sign-in
Tell it who you are in Settings, and correct it with Not like that? under a reply; it remembers
